parentTask: FOCUS-YTM-3 — device-reported 'play gagal, tidak ada notif apapun' fix

qa.newTests: none added (watchdog is Android-looper-bound; existing 86 cover bus/parsers/auth hashing)
qa.deviceTests: NOT RUN in sandbox — user reports the failure from a real A05s; v1.4.1 needs the same manual checklist
qa.fixVerification: static trace only: the three silent paths are code-covered by the watchdog + pre-early-return evaluation; on-device re-test pending

changes: PlaybackRepository: active main-thread watchdog polls StreamErrorBus/queue every 400ms while a resolution is pending — a refused onAddMediaItems fires no player events, so the event-only match never ran; watchdog also synthesizes a TIMEOUT error when the 15s grace lapses with no answer
PlaybackRepository: play()/addToQueue() clear StreamErrorBus first so a stale diagnostic can never short-circuit a fresh attempt

MainActivity: showOrClearPlaybackError() now evaluated BEFORE the no-current-track early return (failed first play leaves the queue empty — exactly when the Snackbar vanished); Snackbar is LENGTH_INDEFINITE until resolved/dismissed
NowPlayingActivity: error banner now also refreshes over the empty state instead of being force-hidden when the queue is empty
PlaybackErrorInfo: KIND_TIMEOUT; PlaybackErrorText maps TIMEOUT -> err_playback_no_response (new string)
